# Agents

## Agentic loop

An **agent** is an LLM given a goal, tools, and the ability to choose its next
action from the results.

![](images/diagrams/agentic-loop.svg){fig-alt="The agentic loop: a goal enters the model, which chooses an action; a tool executes it; the result is added to the context for the next model call; the loop repeats until the model returns a completed result" width="100%" fig-align="center"}

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
One request can trigger **many model calls and tool actions** before the agent
returns a result.
:::
